item.statement: There is no fallback path and no CUDA texture-object or runtime dependency; the only external effect is writing odata, with host-observable error reporting allowed.

plans.objective: Verify the candidate is a native Ascend-C operator without CUDA dependencies or extra external effects.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and build files and read dependency/side-effect sites.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate builds and runs without CUDA runtime or texture APIs and has no external side effects beyond odata and host error reporting.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate source and build configuration for CUDA API calls, texture objects, and side effects; confirm the only output side effect is odata.
